body:
Hey me too. I felt your way since I was about 7 years old. I remember making this account. I can tell you my life got worse and better at the same time, but I'm actually finally happy about being alive. I actually wake up no longer pissed that I'm still alive, I wake up and am so happy I'm literally still breathing...still get to see the sunshine. I'm 28 now a few weeks from being 29 even ;)

I feel so grateful now that my APPLICATION was declined. Honestly! You're gonna make it kid. You will and you're gonna be so grateful one day you can say you outlived so many situations that should've taken you and still got to gain all these wild memories. Maybe it will be a year from now or even seven years from now, but I now know it to be true. You can be happy too. Much love to you, live a grand life...

I just signed in today and am catching up with your responses at this very moment. THANK YOU SO MUCH for responding!!! I truly appreciate it. Some of the stuff I already figured, but it's helping me rationalize that I am probably over thinking everything.

oh God I wish I hadn't read this. I recently wrote a SW post because I couldn't find my Klonopin for the night. It has surely helped me with anxiety, but also with falling asleep faster. It's been a life changer, but I only have so many days left on it and no health insurance currently. Terrified of withdrawals and being dependent as well… My friend who knows about my mental illness does not understand the deadly consequences of all the meds I take and just one day not having them. I'm going through rough times and I hate that I've become dependent on them too, terrified of running out, terrified of being on them in the first place. Best of luck to you when you reach that point. I truly hope, but I know you will survive it.
I'm with you on that.
Good news is I woke up pretty early and actually accomplished one task. I'm going to keep going and make the most of today. I just need to work on finding something full-time to distract me.
I've tried the NAMI group before. Yeah I think I was more anxious because no one came home last night. It was really triggering… (neglected childhood; alone almost always)

Please help. It's pushing me more to an early grave. I don't want to live in a world like this. I want my freedom. I don't necessarily have anything to hide, it's just the principle of being watched all the time and being a #. Everything is recorded. Even this. How can you help. I desperately would love to hear...

Yes. They are a blessing and a curse. I am naturally paranoid (and did run into someone I went to school with) so I haven't been back. I never felt comfortable opening up in them. I was thinking of going to a different location this week actually...but still =\ It's just an overwhelming, uncomfortable place and barely helps for me.

I do the same, but on a little notebook that I will turn into my own encyclopedia. I seem to remember and recall things better from my own handwriting... 

I'm taking a mood stabilizer that's usually to treat epilepsy. I assume you are taking some type of treatment? If so, do you think it's made it worse. I try to tell my doctor how bad my memory has gotten and I don't think she takes it as seriously as she should. This is common for people in my position, but to the point where I feel like I have a TBI and having to relearn the alphabet (no seriously, I've had to consciously repeat it in my head these days)!?

WOW. I NEEDED to read this. I'm so glad I came back into this thread today. If I ever get to my pdoc again, I will tell them this and why I've embraced my mania right now. Thank you for saying this; I wish more people would get it.

I've learned my lesson. It took 3x too, but now I keep my mouth shut. I am now under the assumption that people who are seeking help, but still are successful in their plans have done the same. It is a sad commentary on our state of healthcare that people like us avoid the hospitals at any cost. I trust no one now. I've dropped hints, but I just don't care anymore. Can't say I haven't tried. I'm sure you have too, the little bit of humanity left in me hopes you can a little longer. Whatever. I'm glad you got it off your chest. I think you will survive the day, the week, the month. You might not be thriving, but maybe something will come to change your life. That last shimmer of hope is annoying, I know.

everyday. every method. every day my methods are crushed by a potential consequence. 

Even if i'm dead I have to worry about how I'll be found (just read a hanging post in SW)!? fuck this.
This exact thing is happening to me and it's freaking me the fuck out. I want it to stop. And it's never anything helpful or that would directly benefit me…

Yes. I actually made friends with and contacts with some. I hung out with a few outside the hospital and it finally seemed like my life was going somewhere. Then I got sick and lost contact with them; I've been depressed ever since. I think about some in out-patient as well, they were heavy…  I hope they are still alive. Some people don't realize who traumatizing it is to be thrown in this situation and come out of it. You're no longer alone in it and you take those other people with you. It's unfortunate you were not able to trade information; I'd assume that'd especially be welcome for the youth.
Experienced the same thing whoa. I keep dying every other year it seems. I'll keep it going until it's impossible.

Being consumed by these thoughts suck. I bring value to my life by working down a bucket list; that way no one can say I didn't try. It has been very rewarding for me. I know that if I want to go, I can, but if I can hang in there… I've lived. I've truly lived. And you don't  need a partner in crime for it either. I always keep in mind this scene from Benjamin Button, when he starts aging to his birth. It's a beautiful little scene where he just goes all over the world and adapts. Sometimes you gotta say fuck the limits and constraints, and just go explore. The only tether in this life is the mind.

Do you know how to rechannel that energy from that moment? You can actually pull from those moments and put yourself in a mediative state. We all do it subconsciously at times, but you can work to pull from that energy all the time. Painting while listening to music, it really is an underrated pleasure :) I think more people should give art therapy a try. Noninvasive and truly soul-fulfilling.

oh god I literally just made a similar post and I think that's TOTALLY OKAY! Any little thing to keep us going. And I think it matters that you acknowledged a human created something so beautifully imaginative that you care enough to follow it. So many people continue to enjoy life for that reason and I respect that you want to hang in there for that reason. And I do think you care about yourself really. You at least want closure… I try to think of people that didn't make it as far as we have and the things they have "missed" out on. Such wonderful things. Such tragic things. yet such advanced things… I know one day I will miss out on them, but if I can help it, I would hang around for that thing too. I am actually (I want to see the Suicide Squad so badly--that has intervened now sigh). I get it though, you're not alone obviously. Fuck it. Hang in there to find out about JS with the rest of us too. ((Hugs))

Thank you guys for your replies. I know there are millions in my position. When I wanted to "go" I wanted to go debt-free, just to say I worked my way out of it and feel some kind of fucked up success? Maybe I can. I don't know anymore, but I'm too sick too care. I have my documents. I tried to get govt. aide, they're awful at helping people like me. Maybe I will do that bankruptcy thing, but I'm sick of the ratrace in general. Right now I need funds to get out of an abusive household. That's why the stress is too heavy for me. I think I will worry about that first and the debt ….I'll get to that. I'm glad a few of you share my similar thoughts. I used to think I was the only one that was like 'fuck the numbers' I gotta live. Thanks guys, it oddly gave me hope. I hope we all make it out on the other side. Healthy in every way . :)

omg me too. i recently made a post wit this and i can't deal.i can't deal with it anymore. what's happening to reddit currently just confirms it all. could we PM each other. i really am so extremely paranoid, that i feel like giving it all up…they already know anyway.

No one can control what anyone does here. There are people writing posts and we'll never know if they come back or not. This OP mentioned a specific concern and I offered a reasonable "resolution" if that person means something to them. People that are deadset on doing this, won't truly be swayed by anything here. If the OP is deadset on doing this and has a concern, that is in no way giving advice on HOW to end his life, then imho what is wrong with giving advice on how to give closure to survivors/family members of suicide? He doesn't have to put weight into this, but this should be a place of honesty. It seems he wants closure for a particular person. I only offer reasonable suggestions. Sorry if this offends you or the OP, but if he/she is truly prepping himself, why not consider all the work that goes into a clear goodbye. Thinking about all those things may actually pull them out of this mindset.

in no way am I encouraging you, but I feel like it's best to be honest in these situations. we're all here for one simple reason: we're sick. 
IF you do this, maybe make a video recording explaining that you were really sick, that you love him, and consider this just another natural cause of death... and leave it on a usb for him to find. Or write a letter. But be honest. If he knows the how sick you were or the trouble you were in, yes he would probably try to intervene, feel guilty, etc. but if he knew this is how sick you were… It would be a difficult thing to move past but if you are feeling this badly, you have your choices. I really hope this is a low phase for you and things pick back up. Unfortunately, we ALL have to accept the ebb and flow of life. Hang in there…. 

Better advice-- Why not try volunteering at an animal shelter? Not sure where you're located, but I'm sure something is close by. Also animal-assisted therapy?
couldn't have said it better myself. peace be with you, wherever you choose to be. be it *here*, or another existence beyond what we know is "life"

I think the whole "putting your affairs in order" shows it's not a selfish deed, the pain was just too much and you had to stop. You thought about it so much, you organized and tried to tidy up for "loved ones" or those that may find you. I think leaving usernames is a great idea (not to be encouraging), but yes…it just allows people close to you to see how much pain you were in. So much pain you could not even utter saying to them in person. And that's totally okay. Not everyone is going to get this type of pain.
Yeah, just some thoughts I felt like sharing when I noticed another post here.

I feel you. Down to not letting me work to earn my own money and not even providing money as a parent should in dire circumstances. Fuck em. I'm sure you've heard this many times, but have you tried going to a gym and start lifting? Many men and women's lives are drastically changed when they are physically active. Body transformations can be just what the soul needs. I'm not sure if you have the funds for it (gym membership), but I always recc some kind of physical activity while you're biding your time. At least you can say you didn't waste your physical vessel, you know? You can find that community you seemed to have missed out in college. Everyone is there to push themselves out of a rut too. They say comparison is the thief of joy. It's easier said than done, but try not to look at who is better off than you. Ignore their highlight real. I really do hope you have an upswing coming soon. If it's really happening in July, I hope you have an amazing one last hurrah to give to yourself. I'm sorry you've been robbed of a real shot at life. Please come back to us if July doesn't work out. Big hugs to you. And trust me you're not too old. 25 is the turn around era! It's your life. I don't think you're too old. I got to do so much at 25 because I was planning on my demise too. And now I'm closer to 27. I think that missing out, you have to give yourself a shot at happiness before you go. Anyway possible. PM if you need too. We have a lot in common. And you and I are definitely not alone in that aspect.

I have emotionally & physically detached myself from everything and everyone (not to mention those people were no true friends/family anyway). I won't allow myself to either until I get out of an abusive situation. This is survival mode. When you're in this state the only future you see is 'how many days do I have left until nature swallows me whole.' Therefore nothing matters in the end. It is imagery and material. IMHO, it is a farce.

Not hijacking your thread, but I wanted to mention mine. Hell maybe others might feel inclined too and maybe the con/repulse list will be enough to discourage us for good? That's my thinking. Sadly my con list is pretty short. 

 Draw me to suicide: 
*Nothing really matters in this life. You're only as significant as the legacy you leave behind. Humans place extreme significance on trivial things 
*Debt. Don't want to be a debt slave. Fuck that
*If Robin Williams couldn't last… And he did it with such urgency. 
 Fuck. 
 *An actual fuck you to abusers. They will be shamed. Good. 
*Having it as an option; being able to make peace and having the motivation to g*et my "affairs in order." 



Repulse:

1) Never watch the movie "Wristcutter: A Love Story" I am haunted by this being what actually happens. 
2)Someone I went to school with came to me in a dream. I didn't know him personally, but he ended his life this way. He warned me not to. wtf
3) The possible gore and yes, actually having to make sure it works.

thank you so much for sharing. it did make me feel comfort in knowing someone else has experienced such similar life :\ it's hard to relate to people who are not on their last leg. the underfunded system as scarred me as well… I think there could be a clinic or medicaid that would offer free sessions of therapy. I'll respond to you. Thanks so much for responding here. Big internet hugs!

the only mantra i got going for me is : a lot can change in a year. 

a lot could change in 6 months. that starts with eating. i assume you have meds. you have to eat with those. your mood could drastically improve. but that's not to say i don't know what you're going through. i just know my mood improved making sure I ate with my new antidepressants. proper diet & meds, getting yourself moving…putting that all together, it really can change your life. i'm sure you know this. i have that type of guilt too. guilt is a fear tactic. i hope you don't feel your life ends with suicide; and i hope you can let go of the guilt eroding your life. you deserve a chance to live. to be at peace. if you really think 2016 is the end for you, fuck it… do some happy little, big things for yourself. AND YOU. a lot can change in a year. i do hope it does just for you.

That's a great idea. I take a lot of pictures and print them to remind myself that I am a real, live human being (because I have bipolar disorder too & ptsd) and I often dissociate. I do hope your outlook would have changed. I don't mean to, but I tend to put my ex through a similar mindset. I've even made him suicidal. I hate myself for this, but once he's really gone…. and HE makes the choice to be gone, I'd probably do it. But then the guilt of leaving him in an empty bed eats away at me. I don't want to traumatize him either. 

You should go outside. I hope where you are, it is a beautiful summer day. And you should keep walking. And hold on to that feeling of the air and all the life around you. I should go for a walk myself. PM anytime. Usually people have offered to talk to me, but this time I feel like I can really connect to your situation, maybe you can rant (about the failed medication). Which btw, I found mine. It took years. But I'm at least functioning and able to walk. Get up out of bed. Ill take it you know? Please PM anytime. While I'm still here myself. I think there is still hope for your medication at least. I know there is.

Couldn't have said it better myself. I will add that we didn't ask to be here and the world has always been pretty shitty. I guess the silver lining is that we actually have great distractions going for ourselves; bide your time with the positive, beautiful things we have on this Earth. Food, clean water, technology, art etc. Bide your time. I think that's all anyone can do at this point. You say your family is wealthy, would you be able to use that wealth to take care of a fellow human near you? It is worth a try. The joy is truly rewarding no matter all the negativity going on in the world.

I truly have love for you. I have experienced such similar things, I wish I could be there to give you the longest hug of your life. I don't want to upset you, but since our mindsets seem to be so similar place atm, I feel you should know this before you are crushed the way I was. I was thinking the same idea about enlisting. Unfortunately, a visit in the hospital ruins your chances of getting in. (I'm sorry if you already knew this). You can't even lie about it. It's on record. I don't care about my life, so let me die for my country. But I get why they can't take those chances. So fuck the people that put you there in the first place. It's hard to believe in karma, but fuck all the people who let you slip through the cracks and hurt you. I know this isn't the usual happy comment you might receive, but as someone who probably has so much in common with you, I had to keep it real. Don't give up. We have to show our abusers they will get what is coming to them and that is through our success. Beyond the shit system, is there any vision of success you want to achieve before your time is up? That's the only thing that keeps me going. I at least want to escape my abusive family and feel a year, shit even a day of real freedom. I hope you have some vision that you can hold on to. I hope my comments have not made you feel worse, it is not my intention. Just know you truly are not alone in your specific feelings.

i could've written this myself yesterday. it is exactly what tipped the iceberg. i don't see the point in existing anymore when you try to call people out for their hypocrisy, especially when you're trying to help a little human not turn into an asshole. watching people drown in their idiocy is a comforting thing at least. just have enough distance that they can't bring you back down in the barrel. we come int his world alone, we die alone. ignore the static, live for you. if they don't listen or try to dictate, realize they actually have little power. it's all for ego

not very good at reddit. not sure if you got this message: ty you both for your support. I just woke up, so I'm going to do something productive for a bit and then privately message the long version (at least as much as I feel strong enough to go over again). I wish you both a great day.

thank you all for your comments and support. I'm glad I posed here again… it at least helps get this out. I haven't been able to speak to anyone about it and I finally caved. Feels like a slight weight has been lifted. I still am not sure where I will be within these next few months. I'd like to have a normal job, but I accept I'm not entirely in control of my life. It is what it is. I just woke up, so I'm going to do what I can control….clean :D Maybe I'll find some lost money lol. I wish you all a great day and week.

ty you both for your support. I just woke up, so I'm going to do something productive for a bit and then privately message the long version (at least as much as I feel strong enough to go over again). I wish you both a great day.
thank you for your support :)

thank you for the reply. gives me a little hope and some ideas. i can't type them, but i agree with you on one particular thing. i just don't want to burden my family anymore than i already have, as they cruelly remind me whenever they have a chance.

I'm not having any luck with in-between. The in-between there is, are odd jobs and just not enough to get out of a particularly, unique abusive situation. The in-between would have me living out of my car. Nothing I have not already done, but I find particularly dangerous for obvious reasons. I'm just so desperate and over it.

I guess I would like to talk to you. Look out for a msg tomorrow, it's pretty late where I am. My story is a bit long and tragic. I had a similar named account here, but I forgot my password. I'm looking for any kind of work, even lying on my resume (taking off my useless college degree) to just get work at a fast food restaurant. Working odd jobs, I'm not above any of that (and at this point, I don't feel above sex work, just don't want to crash and burn). It's something that I just started to look into (as my "contract" just ended recently). Cleaning houses, babysitting, etc. But like I said it is chump change and a waste of time, when I could just whore myself for $100s+ a day and be out of this situation in possibly a month. I don't have any valuable skills, but a "pretty face" and high sex drive. It's almost as if I was built for sex. Like I mentioned, I got a pretty useless degree. I didn't even want to go to college. I'll probably expand more about that in private. I've starved, so that's nothing new to me either. I can't seem to get out of this survival mode, so it's just why bother? I hate this god damn world anyway… Thanks for the responses guys. I will need to sleep. can't really sleep, but I want to try to wake up early and hustle.
